name: Demo K2: Rectangular-to-Round Duct Type Redline
description: Exercise a type/family-change redline operation for an MEP duct target: dry-run a rectangular-to-round duct type change, apply it, prove readback, capture post-change evidence, then revert for repeat-safe live runs.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Provide a duct element id and compatible target round duct type id or exact type name in the same duct system context.
Use a low-risk copied sample model and keep revertAfterVerify enabled so repeated live runs restore the original rectangular duct type.
success_criteria: /revit/change-element-type dry-run returns old rectangular duct and new round duct type evidence for every requested duct.
/revit/change-element-type apply returns changed duct element ids covering every requested element.
A post-apply readback proves the duct now has the requested round duct type id.
A post-change visual capture is produced before reverting.
The workflow reverts the duct to its original rectangular type and readback proves restoration.
A type-change summary artifact is written.
failure_criteria: The dry-run cannot resolve the requested round duct type.
The apply response omits any requested duct element id.
Readback does not prove the requested round duct type after apply.
The revert dry-run/apply/readback omits any requested duct element id or fails to restore the original rectangular duct type.
grader_notes: This task adapts the type/family-change evidence contract to the rectangular-to-round duct redline scenario.
Do not count generic success as completion; apply and readback must prove the requested duct ids and target round duct type.
